extraction_notes: J-Book exposure divergence cohort. Focus is the Army Short Range Reconnaissance (SRR) Tranche 2 Program of Record narrative driving forward revenue expectations, plus the DLA SOE TLS, CBP BPA, and Blue UAS DIU programs. Pentagon J-Book corpus (DARPA, MDA, SOCOM, OSD, AF/SF RDT&E + Procurement) does not seed Army sUAS PEs directly, so NOT_FOUND is expected for SRR/Blue UAS lookups -- those are UNVERIFIABLE per heuristic #7, not RED. Also adding USAspending verification claims for SRR T2 awards + Teal historical contracts, and non-J-Book control claims (Autonodyne litigation, patents).

claims.claim_text: Teal is one of two finalists for the U.S. Army Short Range Reconnaissance (SRR) Tranche 2 Program of Record; SRR T2 contract value totaled $5.7M with all milestones complete; Army expected to announce production-award vendor selection by Q4 calendar 2024.
claims.subject: Teal Drones (Red Cat subsidiary)
claims.predicate: is finalist on / expects production award from
claims.object_value: U.S. Army SRR Tranche 2 Program of Record (Tranches 2+3 combined, final tranche)
claims.source_quote: In March 2022, Teal was selected by the DoD's DIU and the U.S. Army to compete in the Short Range Reconnaissance Tranche 2 (SRR T2) Program of Record... narrowed the field from 37 drone manufacturers down to two vendors... As of May 2024, Teal has completed all milestones in its SRR T2 contract, whose value totaled $5.7 million. Teal expects the Army to announce vendor selection of a production award by the fourth quarter of calendar 2024.
